# Fogo de Chão

> > Fogo de Chão is a Brazilian steakhouse chain specializing in churrasco, offering fire-roasted meats, Market Table, Bar Fogo lounges, and private event spaces across the United States and Brazil.

The restaurant features signature experiences including weekday lunch service, Fogo Rewards loyalty program, Bar Fogo cocktail lounges, and comprehensive group dining facilities. Locations span major U.S. cities and São Paulo, Brazil, with amenities like Fogo To-Go takeout and Fogo Butcher Shop.

## Key Topics

- Churrasco (Brazilian barbecue)
- Market Table (salad bar & sides)
- Bar Fogo (cocktail lounges)
- Fogo Rewards (loyalty program)
- Fire-roasted meats
- Group dining & private events
- Brazilian steakhouse experience
- Fogo To-Go (takeout)
- Fogo Butcher Shop
- Happy hour specials
- Corporate events & meeting rooms
- Weekend brunch service
- Wine dinners & pairings
- Catering services
- Rio Grande do Sul culinary traditions

## Dining Experiences & Menus

- [Indulgent Churrasco Lunch](https://fogodechao.com/weekday-lunch): Weekday churrasco lunch menu with Market Table & fire-roasted meats
- [Best of Brazil Promotion](https://fogodechao.com/carnivalevent): Best of Brazil promotion featuring churrasco & rewards program

- [King of Prussia Brazilian Steakhouse](https://fogodechao.com/location/king-of-prussia): King of Prussia location near Mall & Main Line with Bar Fogo

- [Center Norte, São Paulo](https://fogodechao.com/location/shopping-center-norte): Center Norte São Paulo location with happy hour specials & group dining
- [Vila Olimpia, São Paulo](https://fogodechao.com/location/vila-olimpia): Vila Olimpia São Paulo location near business district & nightlife
